description:
The proposed development is identical in every respect to that approved under P2025/2819/LBC, and the sole purpose of this application is to attach the conditions that were agreed between the parties after the decision notice was issued.

The application with ref. number P2025/2819/LBC received approval for the following proposals:
- replacement of existing modern sash windows with new slimline double-glazed sash windows
- retrofitting of original timber sash windows with double glazing and applying of a new finish to the main entrance steps
- installation of a new roof and rooflight to the existing rear closet wing
- enlargement of the existing later roof extension window and addition of a new rooflight
- reinstatement of missing historic mouldings and architectural details across all levels with associated internal layout alterations and refurbishment
- installation of new internal secondary glazing.
reference_no_of_permission_being_relied_: Note: The proposed development is identical in every respect to that approved under P2025/2819/LBC and P2025/2818/FUL, and the sole purpose of this application is to attach the conditions that were agreed between the parties after the decision notice was issued.
